title: The Idilla Series
bodyHtml:
Heritage Refined for the Modern Interior

Crafted by our renowned Italian partners Alice Ceramica, Idilla draws from Italy’s storied ceramic tradition and reinterprets it through a contemporary lens that’s both bold and restrained.

With its soft curvature, generous proportions, and finely resolved detailing, the collection blurs the line between function and sculpture — a series that feels timeless, tactile, and distinctly modern.

Design That Rewards Attention

Hand-finished in Italy, Idilla reveals its character through layers of detail. From a distance, its silhouette feels assured and architectural; up close, gentle transitions and nuanced asymmetries emerge; subtle cues of the maker’s hand.

t’s a collection that rewards close observation. Idilla is measured, balanced, and deeply rooted in material authenticity.


Idilla Oval in Gloss Myrtle - 600 x 350 x 130 mm

The Idilla Structure

Idilla finds its most complete expression when paired with the Idilla Structure — a fully ceramic, hand-formed base that mirrors the basin’s geometry with sculptural precision.

Together, they form a seamless, monolithic composition, where proportion and material converge to create a singular statement within the bathroom space.

Finish, Form, Freedom

Offered in a curated palette of matte and gloss finishes, Idilla invites freedom of expression across diverse design narratives, from serene minimalism to richly layered, emotive interiors.

Crafted entirely from ceramic and defined by generous internal proportions, each basin balances practical versatility with sculptural integrity.

Trends defined, not followed

Idilla is not designed to follow trends, but to outlast them — a refined response to contemporary bathroom design that places equal value on form, function and feeling.
